title: 004 封无的直觉005 黑人与流浪汉
content_zh:
004 封无的直觉
随后看过珍妮的案发现场，封无就和陈同回到警局，只见封无拿出一本笔记本，立即开始写起来。
陈同虽然好奇，不过还是在旁边等待。
一时间只有封无快速挥笔的沙沙声，半小时过后，封无抬头，道：“案件的大致轮廓已经可以确定。”
“能让我看看吗？”陈同立即问道。
封无点点头，将笔记本移到陈同面前，陈同立即看起来。
“第一条，凶手是生手，第二条，凶手年纪二十至二十五岁上下，第三条，凶手是维克多所在学校的学生，第四条，凶手目标为外国人，第五条凶手还会继续作案……。”陈同一句一句的读道，封无足足写了三十多条，其中很多他都不太明白为什么。
接着他抬头看着封无，提出质疑道：“封无先生，你怎么判定凶手是维克多所在大学的学生？”
“因为对方是生手，他需要一个试胆的目标，而维克多恰好进入他的视线，虽然不太清楚凶手的目的，不过他很理智，甚至我感觉他是受到胁迫才不得不杀人，反正这只是我办案多年的个人直觉。”封无说道。
陈同点点头，道：“为什么凶手的目标为外国人，虽然他连续杀害的都是外国人，那其中渡边靠二特征可是无限的接近中国人，对方又怎么知道他是外国人还是华夏人？”
“渡边靠二的死其实应该是一个意外，我看过他的致命伤，那是凶手的第一击，渡边靠二心脏功能不好，所以才会出现一击致命的情况，而珍妮小姐则是太阳穴受到攻击，那是凶手第二击，这个时候的凶手显然心理素质得到了很大的提高，而且变得更加狡猾，他甚至连直剃刀都不需要使用，直接依靠电棒就将两人杀害，那防狼电棒大概是两万伏左右，不然不可能致命。”封无说道。
陈同皱眉道：“难道凶手是种族主义者，我记得维克多那边可是有一位小姐是生还只是当时被电晕而已。”
“不对，对方应该不是种族主义者，反而有点像杀手，甚至作案的人是不同的两个人。”封无忽然低头思考着说道，主要还是资料太少了，不然他还可以更加的精确推断出凶手的目的。
陈同也皱眉看着笔记，这个案件还真棘手，最可怕的是对方杀人的目的，没有丝毫的头绪！
他们已经查过和维克多有关的人员，可惜全都有不在场的证明，而珍妮那边更是毫无头绪，虽然她有几个敌人可能会出手，但那天她是偷偷溜出来玩，就算那些人也不可能掌握她的行踪。
“我们先查一查维克多死的那天，不在学校的学生有哪些，然后再作打算吧。”封无说道。
陈同一愣，随即道：“这不科学吧，毕竟离校的学生不少，一个一个问的话，效率太差。”
“你去学生会，让学生会帮忙统计，同时去找校长，把今届所有学生的资料都送过来。”封无直接说道。
陈同一愣，随即才发现原来还有这样的一个办法，不必自己逐一去问。
等陈同离开后，封无坐在办公椅上面，两手交叉，渐渐沉思。

这凶手的大致轮廓他已经可以想象到，应该是一个健壮的青年，年纪偏小一些，估计就也就是二十三岁左右，他的情况很特殊，估计有精神病一类的问题，例如臆想症，在他幻想中，有一个人威胁他，要他去杀人不杀人会出现不好的事情，他于是在学校里面选择目标，似乎是有外国人特征的人为优先级，他选择了维克多。
之前说有人逼迫，这有点问题，逼迫普通人去杀人，这本身就不太可能，如果是精神病的话就可以解释的通。而恰恰维克多自己屁股也不干净，犯有多起迷奸少女的罪行，所以正好符合凶手的要求。
凶手应该有观察过维克多，或许这里是一个突破口，得询问一下有没有人那几天特别留意维克多。
他下手之前犹豫过，也就是说，他并不想杀人，或者说并非出于他本意去杀人，但最后他却动了手。
封无拿出一张A4白纸，忽然开始画了起来，他的素描功底极强，渐渐就重现出当晚案发现场的一切，虽然没有画出凶手的面容，但大致的轮廓都出来了。
一小时后，陈同就回来了，学生会答应帮忙，不过需要两天的时间，而学生的资料，通过电脑就可以直接查询，而他也已经取得权限。
“哟，还有心情画画。”看到桌面上的A4纸，陈同笑道，不过他拿起来看了一下，渐渐就严肃起来，等看完之后，他才满脸惊讶的看着封无。
封无淡道：“只是将我脑海里面的作案过程画出来，估计有九成凶手就是这样做，一个从没有杀过人的普通居民，能够做到这样已经是极限，毕竟限制太多。”
“你这能力也太变态了吧，我感觉这就是真相！”陈同看着画纸说道。
这时候电话响起，那便衣警察接了电话，随即抬头道：“又发现一具外国人尸体！”
“走，去看看！”封无立即说道。
三人赶到现场，现场已经拉起警戒线，在便衣警察的担保下，封无顺利进去。
死者名叫泰克利，墨西哥人，今年46岁，来华夏是为了度假，以及寻找一些灵感和艳遇。
没错，泰克利是一位设计师，同时还是一位充满浪漫色彩的花花大叔。
不过现在泰克利却躺在偏僻的小巷，面容狰狞，腹部有最少十七处伤口。
封无看到的第一眼就可以想象到当时可怕的画面，凶手凶狠的握着匕首狂捅泰克利的腹部，将他的内脏全都捣碎，甚至连骨头都被刀子挫断。
这死法绝对很痛，难怪泰克利面容如此狰狞。
“死者死亡时间大概是凌晨四点，身上的财物有被搜刮过的痕迹，初步判断是遭遇抢（和谐）劫，反抗不成然后被歹徒杀害。”便衣警察说道。
陈同道：“这应该只是巧合吧，作案的手法差距太大了。”
前面两起案件都是通过防狼电棒击晕对手，然后才下杀手，第一次虽然见了血，但也是一击必杀，而这里却疯狂的多，看那稀巴烂的腹部就可以想象当时的画面有多么的恐怖。

“那为什么目标还是外国人？”便衣警察忽然又觉得有疑点。
陈同笑道：“外国人在国人的心目中那就是有钱的代名词，或许是这个原因吧。”
“封先生，你觉得呢？”便衣警察皱着眉头看向封无。
只见封无看着尸体眼睛都不眨一下，听到便衣警察的话，看了便衣警察一眼，道：“暂时不能肯定，但前面的推断或许出了差错，让我再看看。”
他走上前，看了一下伤口，然后又在四周找了找东西，忽然他似乎察觉到什么，走到尸体前面，仔细的看了对方的手。
“陈同，麻烦过来一下。”封无开口道。
陈同走上前，虽然对尸体很抗拒，但身为警察，四周都是同僚，他也不想露出那种怯懦的情绪，毕竟警察怕见到尸体，也太丢人了。
“你闻一下，他的手是不是有一种奇特的味道。”封无说道。
陈同顿时皱起眉头，就算他不想暴露出自己抗拒的情绪，但怎么也不会变态到去闻尸体的气味吧！
“怎么了？”封无见陈同皱眉，疑惑道。
便衣警察轻笑道：“这家伙估计做不来，还是我来吧！”
他蹲下戴上手套，拿起尸体的手仔细的闻了闻，随即皱眉道：“虽然很轻，但确实有一股臭味，封无，你的鼻子不会是狗鼻子吧，刚刚是怎么发现的？”
“不会是尸臭吧？”陈同淡道。
封无看了陈同一眼，随即道：“这是凶手的气味，凶手应该是环卫工人或者流浪汉，因为和垃圾打交道，身上有一股味道，凶手应该是临时起意，所以并没有处理身体就直接下手。”
“不会吧，光凭气味就可以推断？”陈同怀疑道。
说实话，如果查案都那么容易，还要警察干吗？
“不管那么多，先去环卫所看看，陈同你带人查看一下附近的录像，顺便留意一下附近的流浪汉。”便衣警察也觉得这气味像是那种味道，因为他的母亲以前就做过环卫工人，虽然她每次都洗干净才回来，但还是带有一点味道，很熟悉。
去环卫所回来，基本上可以排除是环卫工人作案，那么大概是附近的流浪汉作为。
当然，便衣警察也没有排除掉其他的可能性，而另一边封无却在看学生的资料，安静无比。
“看来事情变得有趣了。”半小时之后，封无低头细声的说道，嘴角渐渐翘起。

他可以肯定，其中一个凶手就隐藏在这些毫无出彩的学生之中，只不过他也没办法立即确定凶手。
而且对方并不是愚蠢的人，虽然犯案手法略显稚嫩，但却不会留下关键的证据。
不过正是这样，事情才有趣。
精神病人？
还是有什么隐藏着的秘密呢？
content_en:
004 Feng Wu’s intuition
After seeing Jenny's crime scene, Feng Wu and Chen Tong returned to the police station. Feng Wu took out a notebook and started writing immediately.
Although Chen Tong was curious, he still waited nearby.
For a moment, there was only the rustle of Feng Wu's rapid pen strokes. Half an hour later, Feng Wu raised his head and said, "The general outline of the case has been determined."
"Can you let me take a look?" Chen Tong asked immediately.
Feng Wu nodded and moved the notebook in front of Chen Tong, who immediately looked at it.
"The first is that the murderer is a novice, the second is that the murderer is between twenty and twenty-five years old, the third is that the murderer is a student from Victor's school, the fourth is that the murderer targets foreigners, the fifth is that the murderer will continue to commit crimes..." Chen Tong read sentence by sentence, and Feng Wu wrote more than thirty clauses, many of which he didn't quite understand why.
Then he looked up at Feng Wu and questioned: "Mr. Feng Wu, how do you determine that the murderer is a student of Victor's university?"
"Because the other party is a novice, he needs a target to test his courage, and Victor just happened to come into his sight. Although he is not sure about the murderer's purpose, he is very rational. I even feel that he was forced to kill because of coercion. Anyway, this is just my personal intuition after many years of handling cases." Feng Wu said.
Chen Tong nodded and said: "Why is the target of the murderer foreigners? Although the people he killed continuously are all foreigners, the characteristics of Watanabe Kouji are infinitely close to Chinese. How does the other party know whether he is a foreigner or a Chinese?"
"The death of Kouji Watanabe should actually be an accident. I have seen his fatal injuries. It was the murderer's first blow. Watanabe Kouji's heart function was not good, so the fatal blow occurred. Miss Jenny was attacked on the temple, and that was the murderer's second blow. This The murderer at this time had obviously greatly improved his psychological quality and became more cunning. He didn't even need to use a straight razor, but directly relied on an electric baton to kill the two people. The anti-wolf electric baton was about 20,000 volts, otherwise it would not have been fatal," Feng Wu said.
Chen Tong frowned and said: "Could the murderer be a racist? I remember that there was a lady on Victor's side who survived but was stunned at the time."
"No, the other person is not a racist, but a bit like a killer. Even the perpetrators are two different people." Feng Wu suddenly lowered his head and said in thought. The main reason was that there was too little information, otherwise he could more accurately infer the murderer's purpose.
Chen Tong also frowned and looked at his notes. This case is really difficult. The most terrifying thing is that the other party has no clue as to the purpose of killing!
They have checked the people related to Victor, but unfortunately all of them have alibi, and Jenny has no clue. Although she has a few enemies who may take action, she sneaked out to play that day, and even those people cannot grasp her whereabouts.
"Let's first check which students were not in school on the day Victor died, and then make plans." Feng Wu said.
Chen Tong was stunned, and then said: "This is not scientific, after all, there are many students leaving school. It would be too inefficient to ask one by one."
"Go to the student union and ask the student union to help with statistics. At the same time, go to the principal and send over the information of all students this year." Feng Wu said directly.
Chen Tong was stunned, and then he realized that there was such a way, and he didn't have to ask one by one.
After Chen Tong left, Feng Wu sat on the office chair, crossed his hands, and gradually pondered.
He could already imagine the general outline of the murderer. He should be a strong young man, a bit younger, probably about twenty-three years old. His situation is very special. He probably has mental problems, such as delusional disorder. In his fantasy, a person threatens him, asking him to kill someone. If he doesn't kill someone, something bad will happen.Because of love, he chose a target in school. It seemed that people with foreign characteristics were given priority, and he chose Victor.
I said before that someone was forcing someone to do it, which is a bit problematic. Forcing ordinary people to kill people is impossible in itself. If it is mental illness, it can be explained. And it just so happens that Victor himself has a dirty butt and has committed many crimes of raping young girls, so he just meets the requirements of the murderer.
The murderer must have observed Victor. Maybe this is a breakthrough. I need to ask if anyone paid special attention to Victor in those days.
He hesitated before taking action, which meant that he did not want to kill, or that he did not kill out of his original intention, but in the end he took action.
Feng Wu took out a piece of A4 white paper and suddenly started to draw. His sketching skills were very strong, and he gradually reconstructed everything at the crime scene that night. Although the murderer's face was not drawn, the general outline was revealed.
An hour later, Chen Tong came back. The student union promised to help, but it would take two days. Students' information can be directly queried through the computer, and he has obtained permission.
"Oh, I'm still in the mood to draw." Chen Tong smiled when he saw the A4 paper on the table, but he picked it up and looked at it, and gradually became serious. After reading it, he looked at Feng Wu with surprise.
Feng Wudan said: "I just drew the crime process in my mind. It is estimated that 90% of the murderers did this. For an ordinary resident who has never killed anyone, being able to do this is already the limit. After all, there are too many restrictions."
"Your ability is too perverted, I feel like this is the truth!" Chen Tong said while looking at the drawing paper.
At this time, the phone rang, and the plainclothes policeman answered the phone, then raised his head and said: "Another foreigner's body was found!"
"Let's go and take a look!" Feng Wu said immediately.
The three people rushed to the scene, where a cordon had been set up. With the guarantee of the plainclothes police, Feng Wu entered smoothly.
The deceased's name was Tekeli, a 46-year-old Mexican. He came to China for vacation and to find some inspiration and romantic encounters.
Yes, Tekeli is a designer and a romantic playboy.
But now Tekeli was lying in a remote alley with a hideous face and at least seventeen wounds on his abdomen.
Feng Wu could imagine the horrific scene at the first sight. The murderer fiercely stabbed Tekeli in the abdomen with a dagger, smashing all his internal organs, and even the bones were broken by the knife.
This way of death is definitely painful, no wonder Tekeli looks so hideous.
"The deceased died around 4 a.m., and his belongings showed signs of being plundered. It is initially determined that he was robbed (Harmony), failed to resist, and was killed by the gangsters," said the plainclothes policeman.
Tongdao Chen said: "This should be just a coincidence. The methods of committing crimes are very different."
In the previous two cases, the opponent was stunned with a wolf-proof electric baton, and then the killer was killed. Although there was blood in the first time, he was still killed with one blow, but here it was much crazier. Looking at the smashed abdomen, you can imagine how terrifying the scene was at that time.
"Then why are the targets still foreigners?" The plainclothes policeman suddenly felt suspicious again.
Chen Tong said with a smile: "Foreigners are synonymous with wealth in the minds of Chinese people. Maybe this is the reason."
"Mr. Feng, what do you think?" The plainclothes policeman frowned and looked at Feng Wu.
I saw Feng Wu looking at the corpse without blinking. After hearing the plainclothes policeman's words, he glanced at the plainclothes policeman and said, "I'm not sure yet, but my previous inference may be wrong. Let me take a look again."
He stepped forward, looked at the wound, and then looked around for something. Suddenly he seemed to notice something. He walked to the body and looked at the other person's hand carefully.
"Chen Tong, please come here." Feng Wu said.
Chen Tong stepped forward, although he was very concerned about the corpse.He resisted, but as a policeman, surrounded by his colleagues, he didn't want to show that cowardly mood. After all, the police were afraid of seeing the corpse, which would be too embarrassing.
"Smell it, does his hand have a strange smell?" Feng Wu said.
Chen Tong frowned immediately. Even if he didn't want to reveal his resistance, he wouldn't be so perverted as to smell the corpse!
"What's wrong?" Feng Wu asked in confusion when he saw Chen Tong frowning.
The plainclothes policeman chuckled and said: "This guy probably can't do it, so I'll do it!"
He squatted down and put on his gloves, picked up the corpse's hand and smelled it carefully, then frowned and said: "Although it is very light, there is indeed a smell, Feng Wu, your nose is not a dog's nose, is it? How did you find out just now?"
"Isn't it the smell of corpses?" Chen Tong said calmly.
Feng Wu glanced at Chen Tong and then said: "This is the smell of the murderer. The murderer should be a sanitation worker or a homeless person. Because he works with garbage, there is a smell on his body. The murderer probably acted on impulse, so he attacked directly without treating the body."
"No way, can you deduce it just by smell?" Chen Tong asked doubtfully.
To be honest, if investigating crimes is so easy, why do we need the police?
"No matter how much, let's go to the sanitation station first. Chen Tong, please take some people to check the nearby videos, and pay attention to the homeless people nearby." The plainclothes policeman also felt that the smell was like that, because his mother had worked as a sanitation worker before, and although she came back after cleaning it every time, it still had a little smell and was very familiar.
After going to the sanitation station and coming back, we can basically rule out that the sanitation workers committed the crime, so it was probably the homeless people nearby.
Of course, the plainclothes police did not rule out other possibilities. On the other side, Feng Wu was looking at the student's information and was extremely quiet.
"It seems that things have become interesting." Half an hour later, Feng Wu lowered his head and said softly, with the corners of his mouth gradually raised.
He was certain that one of the murderers was hidden among these unspectacular students, but he couldn't immediately identify the murderer.
And the other party is not a stupid person. Although the method of committing the crime is a bit immature, he will not leave any key evidence.
But that's where things get interesting.
Mental patient?
Or is there any hidden secret?
